description: Classic keyword data for a seed term. Omit ideas when the user only needs that seed's monthly search volume, CPC, or competition. Set ideas:true only when the user asks for related, alternative, or long-tail suggestions from provider candidates. Not a multi-model AI-search query. The reply echoes requestedKeyword and carries status "exact" or "no_data"; when the seed has no search volume, any related term that does appears under alternatives — never treat an alternative's metrics as the requested keyword's. Billed by outcome: cheapest when the seed has no search volume, more when it has metrics, most with ideas:true. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

country.description: ISO-2 country code for localized metrics. Defaults to "us".

ideas.description: Omit for volume, CPC, and competition on the seed only. Set true only for related, alternative, or long-tail keyword ideas.

language.description: Optional ISO-2 language code. Defaults to the country's primary search language, so country "de" searches in German. Only multilingual markets accept an override: us (en, es), ca (en, fr), in (en, hi). Every other country has a single search language and rejects anything else.

seed.description: Seed keyword or concise topic to fetch search volume, CPC, and competition for.

name: cite42_keywords
